mentions.name: flatland-client
mentions.description: A web-based drawing app for drafting home sewing patterns, blending CAD-style precision with sketching flexibility. Currently early-stage with Bezier tools being added; of the intended draft, lay out, print, repeat workflow, only the draft step is functional so far.
mentions.problem: Home pattern-drafting tools are hard to use and expensive; the app aims to make home drafting easier and 100x cheaper.
mentions.audience: Home sewists and hobbyists drafting their own sewing patterns.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a simple web-based drawing app for home sewing patterns. It's a little bit CAD and a little bit sketching tool. Born of my desire for easier and 100x cheaper home drafting tools.

evidence.value: I'm building a simple web-based drawing app for home sewing patterns. It's a little bit CAD and a little bit sketching tool. Born of my desire for easier and 100x cheaper home drafting tools.
